Subject: IAM and SOC 2 follow-up from today's discovery

Marissa / team,

Thanks for the demo earlier — that was helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security team:

1) SOC 2: can you confirm current SOC 2 status, latest report date, and if you provide a SOC 2 summary we can share with our auditors?
2) SSO/SCIM: we need details on SAML SSO support (IdP metadata format, SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated), SCIM provisioning (SCIM v2 support, endpoints, auth method), and whether you support group sync and role mapping.
3) RBAC & admin controls: what's the granularity of admin roles? Can we restrict project-level admins and view-only auditors?
4) Vendor security questionnaire: we received an external RFI — can we kick off the vendor questionnaire via your security portal / provide a contact to send the doc to?

Our timeline: procurement needs SOC 2 summary and SCIM details by EOD Wednesday 4/21. Let us know if that works.

Thanks,
James Porter
Sr. Security Analyst
Ceres Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Porter <james.porter@cereshealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM and SOC 2 follow-up from today's discovery

James — thanks for the clear list. Below are answers and next steps; attaching a short SOC 2 summary and our SSO configuration guide for your IdP team.

SOC 2: Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for security (report completed 2026-11). I've attached "redwood-soc2-summary.pdf" which highlights scope, control areas, and contact for full report requests (we can start an NDA process if you need the full report).

SSO / SAML: we support SAML 2.0 (both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated). Attachment "redwood-sso-config-guide.pdf" includes expected ACS URL, Entity ID, required attributes (email, givenName, familyName), and certificate thumbprint format. For metadata exchange we can provide metadata XML or a metadata URL.

SCIM provisioning: we support SCIM v2 for user provisioning and deprovisioning. Auth is via a scoped bearer token — we provide per-tenant integration credentials. SCIM supports user-level attributes and group membership; group-to-role mapping is supported via claims or via our admin console mapping table. Example endpoints are in the config guide.

RBAC & admin controls: we provide role templates: Owner (full), Admin (manage users, configs, and integrations), Developer (deployments & usage), Billing (view & manage billing), Viewer (read-only). You can restrict roles at the organization or project level; auditors can be assigned a Viewer+Logs role for read-only access to logs/dashboards.

Vendor questionnaire: happy to accept your security questionnaire. Please send the doc to security-portal@redwood.ai or attach here. If you prefer, we can kick off the questionnaire in our vendor portal — I've pasted a link to a shared Drive folder in the metadata where we can drop evidence.

Next steps / ask from you:
- Please confirm which IdP you use and whether you prefer metadata XML or manual fields.
- If you want SCIM provisioning, share the appropriate test account to validate provisioning (we'll provide a tenant token).
- Send the vendor security questionnaire PDF to security-portal@redwood.ai (or reply-all).

I've looped in Aditya (security lead) and Dev (SRE/product) to help with any technical follow-ups. We can also schedule a 30-min technical walkthrough with your IdP engineer — here are a few slots: Tue 4/20 10:00-10:30am PT, Wed 4/21 2:00-2:30pm PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-sso-config-guide.pdf

Hi Lara — quick responses and next steps:

- Okta metadata: metadata URL is available; I'll DM it via HubSpot and also post to the Drive folder. Expect it by EOD today.
- SCIM token rotation: tokens are long-lived but we recommend rotating tokens every 90 days; we support issuing scoped tokens limited to provisioning-only. We'll provide a tenant token scoped to SCIM provisioning for your test account.
- Custom roles + group mapping: yes, you can map SCIM groups to custom roles. Our mapping table in the admin console supports group-to-role mapping; we can demo this in the technical walkthrough.
- Audit logs: attaching a sanitized screenshot showing admin audit events for user provisioning and group changes (iam-controls-screenshot.png). If you need a specific export format we can produce a CSV under an NDA.

Action items:
- Marissa: drop Okta metadata URL in HubSpot and Drive (doing now).
- Lara: share test Okta account/user for SCIM validation (or indicate a preferred test user email).
- James / procurement: send the vendor security questionnaire PDF to security-portal@redwood.ai — we'll triage and return answers within 48 business hours.
- Aditya/Dev: schedule 30-min technical walkthrough once Lara confirms test account.

If those items are green, we should have everything procurement needs by Wed EOD.

Best,
Marissa
